correctness.rationale: The normalized uniform spanning-tree count of K_{n1,...,nk} follows from the Laplacian eigenvalues. For any forced leaf subset S the residual spanning tree and separate grafts give F(S)=((N-|S|)/N)^(k-2) ∏_i[(d_i-(|S|-s_i))/d_i]^(n_i-1). Empty and singleton residuals and zero powers are explicitly treated. Each nonnegative affine-decrement factor satisfies the discrete inequality (x-1)^2-x(x-2)=1, yielding two-addition log-submodularity for every positive part-size vector. k=2 cross-part equality and k>=3 strictness follow from whether a common factor sees both additions. The independent edge-subset verifier matches rational tree enumeration on small graphs; it cannot prove the unrestricted theorem.
